title: 346 certify the released Guava long traversal for every legal length
description: The previous public rule refused the long descriptor. Re-extract the unchanged release JAR bytecode and verify lload, laload and lcmp over signed 64-bit values, leaving the 32-bit cursor invariant, pre-state array, exit and ranking checks intact. Admit unequal elements with identical low 32 bits.
expected: Every frozen obligation meets its expectation, with a real independent JVM witness for each refutation.
